newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline up $3 on strong NYMEX showing.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline up $3 on strong NYMEX showing.

text.p: NWE gasoline stormed $3 or so higher on Wednesday taking its lead from stronger NYMEX gasoline which led the energy complex late yesterday.

Dealers said eurograde barges were pegged around $186-188 fob, up to $3 stronger with $187.25 heard done on an end-July barge. The U.S. strength, prompted by bullish API data released yesterday, also propelled NWE cargo levels to $185-186.
The renewed vigour of the American market could easily start drawing European product trans-atlantic if U.S. prices are viewed as sustainable, traders said.
